name: palette-drift
title: Palette drift
summary: A calm bed of full-strength colour whose hues slowly travel across the structure. A good bottom layer.

name: rising-sweep
title: Rising sweep
summary: Bands of colour climb every surface like a tide of light, trading a base colour for a sweep colour.

name: depth-wave
title: Playa wave
summary: Colour rolls from the playa front to the back of the nave through a three-colour palette.

name: rose-ripple
title: Rose ripple
summary: Rings of light spread in 3D from the rose window through the arches, towers and spires.

name: spire-helix
title: Tower helix
summary: Candy stripes spiral up round each tower and its spire, turning as they climb.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
summary: Slow curtains of green and violet drift over a deep night-blue sky, drawn with fractal noise.

name: fire
title: Fire
summary: Flames lick up from the bottom of whatever the layer lands on, ember red to white-hot.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
summary: Shooting stars race along every arch, spire strand and canopy run, trailing fading tails.

name: twinkle
title: Starfield
summary: Every LED a star with its own rhythm, glinting over a slowly shifting night sky.

name: rose-chase
title: Rose chase
summary: Petals light in turn round the rose window like clock hands while rings breathe outward.

name: plasma
title: Plasma
summary: The demoscene classic: a sum of sine waves wrapped round the structure, through rainbow or cosine palettes.

name: lighthouse
title: Lighthouse
summary: Beams sweep round the vertical axis, washing each face of the layer as they pass.

name: heartbeat
title: Heartbeat
summary: A lub-dub swell at a set tempo, spreading outward from the centre of the layer.
